topicLabels.note: Subject-topic labels, which are what the official 90-question blueprint is built from. The extractor leaves `topic`, `category` and `sign_type` null by design, and no bank carries them, so without this file no question can be placed in a quota. A label decides only WHICH QUOTA a question counts toward - it never touches the question, its options or its stated answer.
